content: Step 3 removes the benzoyl, which is the one thing still holding QED down. Adding the fluorine shifts the benzoyl ipso carbon from index 16 to 17, as it did when I ran this same sequence on the pyrimidine analogue, and atom 1 remains the amide carbonyl; that bond is non-ring. I attach a cyclopropyl rather than a methyl so the product is distinct from my existing leader and lands near 271 Da, closer to the molecular-weight band QED rewards than 245, while cyclopropanecarboxamide keeps rotatable bonds at 2 and SA low. Expected result: a 3-fluoroaniline capped as a cyclopropanecarboxamide, bearing a para pyridin-2-ylamino - two conjugated NH links, both donors free, monocyclic azine with its nitrogen ortho to the NH, LogP near 2.9, two aromatic rings.
